775.description: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.
775.effect: User loses 33% of its Max HP. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. Fails if the user would faint, or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed stat cannot go any higher.

776.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
776.effect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.

777.description: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.
777.effect: Raise the targets Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

778.description: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
778.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

779.description: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.
779.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

780.description: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
780.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

783.description: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.
783.effect: Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage. In Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. In Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. Fails unless the user is Hangry Mode or Full Belly Mode Morpeko.

784.description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.
784.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

785.description: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

786.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

787.description: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
787.effect: Lower the targets Special Defense by 1 stage.

788.description: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
788.effect: Lower the targets Defense by 1 stage. Damage is increased by 50% during Gravitys effect.

789.description: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
789.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

790.description: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.
790.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

791.description: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
791.effect: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

792.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.
792.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn. If this blocks a contact move, the user has their Defense lowered by 2 stages.

793.description: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.
793.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

794.description: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.
794.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

795.description: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.
795.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

796.description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.
796.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

797.description: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.
797.effect: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.

798.description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.
798.effect: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.

799.description: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.
799.effect: Inflicts regular damage two to five times in a row, raising the user’s Speed and lowering the user’s Defense by one stage each upon last hit.

800.description: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
800.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn.

801.description: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.
801.effect: Has a chance to poison the target. This switches categories between physical and special, depending on which would deal more damage to the target. If the damage is tied, it is randomly chosen. This calculation ignores any modifiers other than stat stages.

802.description: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.
802.effect: If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%. Fails if any active Pokemon has the ability Damp.

803.description: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.
803.effect: If Grassy Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its priority increased by 1.

804.description: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.
804.effect: If Electric Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its power doubled.

805.description: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
805.effect: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.

806.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
806.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

807.description: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.
807.effect: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.

808.description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.
808.effect: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.

809.description: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.
809.effect: Fails if the target has no held item.

810.description: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
810.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

811.description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.
811.effect: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

812.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
812.effect:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

813.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
813.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses.

Skill Link does not apply.

814.description: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
814.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

815.description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.
815.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

816.description: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
816.effect: Each Pokemon on the user's side has its status condition healed and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded up.

817.description: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.
817.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

818.description: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.
818.effect: Hits three times. Always scores a critical hit.

819.description: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
819.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

820.description: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
820.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

821.description: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.
821.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

822.description: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.
822.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

823.description: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
823.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

824.description: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

825.description: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

826.description: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
826.effect: The target loses 3 PP from the last move it used.

827.description: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

828.description: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

829.description: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

830.description: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

831.description: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.
